finalText:
Written to `HANDOFF.md`.

**Root cause.** `dep-4471` flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `true`. The pool holds 20. It saturated 18 seconds later and stayed there.

**Window.** 02:14:18Z to at least 03:59:27Z. It never recovers in the log.

**Roll back `dep-4471`.** Flip that key back. Also put `upstreamMs` back to 2000.

Two things I found while writing it up. Every non-health request has failed since 02:14. Another 212 requests just hung with no status logged at all, so dashboards undercount this.

The log is `node-3 of 3`. Real impact may be triple. Worth checking the other two nodes.
